checklist.reason: simple tier + single radially symmetric form with two repeated micro systems (rings, slash arms) both axially/rotationally regular. All 5 identity details enumerated by hand in assessment.preSpecAssessment.detailInventory.details, each maps to a component localFeature, repetitionSystem or material localOverride.

References are AI-generated stylized renders, not photographs - no ground-truth pixels to project. Runtime caps textures at one basecolor <=512px (docs/VISUAL.md section 8) and discards every channel except map+color. Palette of record is assets/prompts/breads/campagne.json geometry.crust plus one sibling-file reuse (baguette.json crumb hex) and one documented deterministic darken, all hand-transcribed (types.ts section 8).
